R1.description: After priming, every tested version is read back from the release cache; one the cache does not serve is a PrimingError naming the version, the cache and one next step, exit 2, before any unit starts

R2.description: A run that starts units refuses, before priming, when free space of the filesystem the run directory is created on (--results when given, else the effective TMPDIR) is below the named minimum, naming the path, the lever (--results or TMPDIR) and the numbers; exit 2, same error family; --list, --plan-only and the other non-unit modes are never refused for space

R3.description: The minimum is a named constant chosen from a measured full-run peak, stated in the plan; #125 is explained as not reproduced and its repeat becomes the read-back refusal

R4.description: Each refusal has a deterministic hermetic test (injected free space, faked cache report, no network), a no-write proof and a failure-only mutation; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md Priming bullet updated; fix: title releases a patch; roadmap row 25 Current at planning, Done at acceptance
